fine_mapping.entry_gate: Every PRIMARY_PHASE1 canonical cross-method shared locus; QC-failed sensitivity loci remain separate
fine_mapping.ld_source: LAVA UK Biobank LD v1.1, European ancestry, GRCh37

colocalization.shared_signal_rule: PP.H4 >= 0.80 and PP.H4/PP.H3 >= 5 with passing fine-mapping/LD QC
colocalization.prior_robust_rule: Shared-signal rule passes at every locked p12 value
colocalization.single_signal_fallback: coloc.abf only when no credible set is estimable and the single-signal assumption is explicitly justified

molecular_integration.claim_limit: Molecular association or prediction does not prove mediation or causality

regulatory_mapping.claim_limit: Regulatory overlap is annotation unless linked by signal-level and context-matched evidence

pathways.gene_input: High-confidence convergent genes only; nearest-gene-only assignments are forbidden
pathways.multiple_testing: BH FDR within each frozen resource/test family

causal_inference.timing: last downstream layer after locus and molecular analyses
causal_inference.claim_rule: Causal language requires concordant robust estimators, adequate instruments, no material pleiotropy warning, and compatible colocalization

robustness.major_conclusion_rule: Every major conclusion must have a row for every applicable robustness family and no unresolved result-changing contradiction

release.name: atlas-v1.0
release.condition: All acceptance gates complete, all required validators pass, no synthetic artifact is included, and the exact code commit and file checksums are frozen
